messages:
devon: FYI, us-west-3 GPU pool provisioning stalled after midnight keystore rotation. Tasks stuck in 'awaiting keystore' and agents show KMS 403. Opening thread.

maria: seeing same. Warmup jobs keep retrying, backoff increasing. Pods in Pending with MountVolumeErrors.

raj: logs from keystore-proxy: "access denied: grant not found" — looks like rotation changed allowed principals.

linh: any firewall or VPC egress changes around the rotation window?

devon: nothing intentional. There's an automated default-deny apply at 02:00 but we had an exception for auditshipper, which looks like it was dropped in the ACL PR.

sam: Confirmed: PR #6794 updated subnets and removed the service-account tag for keystore-exception. Reverting now.

ops-bot: deploy started: reapply-exception-6794 (helm rollout restart keystore-proxy) by sam

maria: while we revert, can we hot-fix by adding an IAM grant to the keystore principal? KMS error indicates missing grants.

raj: yes, grant to role arn:aws:iam::000000000:role/keystore-proxy-usw3 will fix immediate 403. I'll run.

linh: watch audit logs — we saw a huge spike in exports around rotation window. Could incur egress charges if retention keeps at 365d.

devon: concern: auditshipper kept retrying because proxy couldn't authenticate -> backlog of logs exported later. Cost estimate? @finance

sam: quick calc: backlog ~1.2TB, S3 egress + SIEM ingestion ~ $120/day if we push to external. If we keep retention 365 it's ~x. Recommend temp retention 90d for now.

maria: operational priority: unblock GPU pool. Cost discussion after stabilization.

raj: applied IAM grant, restarting keystore-proxy. Patch rolled. Logs now show successful Decrypt requests.

ops-bot: keystore-proxy rollout successful (pod/keystore-proxy-7f4c ready)

devon: provisioning resumed. GPU nodes joining. Warmup success on 3 nodes so far.

linh: created a short checklist: 1) revert ACL PR 6794 (sam) 2) run IAM grant audit for keystore principals (raj) 3) backfill keystore grants across regions (maria) 4) audit export throttle + retention proposal (devon)

sam: reverted PR and re-applied exception. I left a comment on the PR about not removing the tag without cross-team approval.

maria: I'll start backfill tomorrow morning across eu/us/ap. Will coordinate with infra on maintenance windows.

devon: for the retention/economic decision, propose temporary 90d retention and spike alerting for exports. If exports >500GB/day then trigger cost mitigation playbook.

linh: drafting RFC with numbers + egress cost projections. Will ping security & finance for SLAs.

triage-bot: incident closed: GPU provisioning stall (keystore rotation) — root cause: missing exception in subnet ACL + missing IAM grant; mitigations applied. Follow-up RFC assigned to linh.

devon: thanks everyone. Let's follow up in the RFC channel. Short postmortem later with simple timeline and cost impact.

maria: noted. We'll also add an automated check in our rotation job to verify service principal grants before rotation completes. Idea: dry-run decrypt using a sentinel key.

raj: adding unit to keystore-ops playbook: verify grants, smoke decrypt, and audit push. I'll PR.

sam: reminder: if we keep retention lower we need to ensure compliance ok for regulated customers. Loop in compliance.

devon: good call. I'll add compliance to RFC reviewers.

maria: closing thread; all green in us-west-3 now :thumbsup:
